name: Milena Petrović
bio:
Milena's fascination with motorsport began in her childhood, watching Formula 1 races with her father in Belgrade. This early passion fueled her pursuit of a mechanical engineering degree, specializing in aerodynamics. After graduating, she gained valuable experience at a smaller racing outfit, where she honed her skills in data analysis, vehicle dynamics, and race strategy. Her meticulous approach and innovative solutions quickly earned her recognition.

At Anderson Racing, Milena is responsible for overseeing all technical aspects of the team's racing program. She thrives on the challenge of optimizing car performance and ensuring the team is competitive. Milena fosters a collaborative environment, encouraging her team to think creatively and push the boundaries of what's possible. Known for her calm demeanor under pressure, she's a vital asset to the team during critical moments.

What sets Milena apart is her ability to blend technical expertise with intuitive understanding of the car's behavior on track. She believes in constant refinement and adaptation, making her a driving force behind the team's pursuit of excellence.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight, usually pulled back into a neat ponytail
physical.description: Milena is of medium height, with a focused and intelligent expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical drawings and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific type of Serbian coffee before every race.
